Life expectancy is influenced by factors such as healthcare quality, lifestyle, socioeconomic conditions, and environmental factors.  
Hawaii often ranks highest in life expectancy among U.S. states due to factors like a healthy diet, active lifestyle, strong social networks, and good healthcare access.  
California and Florida also have relatively high life expectancies, but Hawaii consistently tops national studies.  
Alaska has a lower life expectancy due to harsher living conditions and healthcare access issues.
